title: The waiting page lets you clear an answer or say "none of these"
why: Your gripe, Oct 26 (waiting page, item 27): you could not unselect an answer, and none of the three options was right.
note: Pilot fixed Oct 26 by the waiting-page thread (version 3, https://claude.ai/artifact/9PJB2skRSMtCC4XHvzbmB8; source plans/c71-waiting-page.html in project files): every decision has a "None of these" option that needs a note saying what you want instead, and every item has a Clear button that removes the draft or the saved answer; the answer line reads "N none of these (note)". claude-settings part: PR #646 (waiting page: clear an answer or say "none of these"), two Sonnet review rounds, round 2 clear; head 8ecd5bb sent to the build advisor for the next integration batch. The template has both controls; the skill reads "none" as a request for new options (its own step in Route and close) and a cleared answer as no answer; 8 browser tests in skills/waiting-page/tests run in the gates-shoot job. Port: yes, every repo's page comes from the skill. Placed after c80, ahead of c76 (triage, Oct 26).
